description: Update a todo (partial): title, notes, due_at, priority, done (true stamps completed_at), timezone, escalate_at, escalate_to (set a NEW escalation step — a step that has fired is spent, so the next one is set by whoever takes over). Use done=true to mark complete. Times without a UTC offset are read as wall-clock time in the caller's timezone (pass timezone, an IANA name, to override).

done.description: Mark complete (true stamps completed_at) or reopen

todo_id.description: ID of the to-do to change

name: update_todo
